subject.title: doctor --fix migrates codex/gpt-5.5 to openai/gpt-5.5, then Codex app-server startup times out on 2026.6.1

question: Should this issue close only after the shared legacy Codex migration-plan policy lands, only after the Codex app-server startup-timeout fix lands, or after both are proven together?
rationale: Current main still has the reported migration and runtime path, while the remaining work is split across two open PRs and includes a maintainer-owned migration policy choice.

options.title: Land migration plan plus startup proof
options.body: Refresh and review PR 93180, decide whether PR 89442 is also needed, and close only after a real upgrade or doctor smoke proves the combined path.

options.title: Treat migration plan as sufficient
options.body: Accept that unsafe doctor migration is the root cause, land the migration-plan repair, and leave the startup timeout tracked only by its narrower issue.

options.title: Keep current migration policy
options.body: Decide that doctor should keep canonicalizing this route and handle the reported failure through Codex startup-timeout hardening or user migration guidance.

recommendation.title: Land migration plan plus startup proof
recommendation.body: Refresh and review PR 93180, decide whether PR 89442 is also needed, and close only after a real upgrade or doctor smoke proves the combined path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to current blame on the relevant paths and already provided maintainer direction on the adjacent legacy Codex migration-plan issue.
